capabilities: run interactive shells in sidebar tabs and tmux-style splits
launch installed AI agent CLIs such as Claude Code and Codex via presets
drag notes, folders or files into the terminal to insert quoted paths
keep sessions running in closed tabs and restore tabs and scrollback after restart
match terminal colors to the Obsidian theme
extras: Desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.13.1 or later. Early release tested live only on macOS; Windows and Linux adapters are included but unverified in-app. Terminal scrollback is saved inside the vault under .obsidian/plugins/sidebar-terminal/scrollback/ unless disabled. More usage detail lives in docs/usage.md rather than the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in terminal, so running shells, scripts or AI CLI agents means switching to a separate terminal app instead of working beside your notes.

relations.evidence: Run Claude Code, Codex and other terminal agents beside your notes.

summary: Sidebar terminal for Obsidian with native tabs and tmux-style splits, preset launchers for AI CLI agents like Claude Code and Codex.
